description: Frozen S2.2 request wording covering complete, first-K manifest-ordered, and Boolean existence retrieval across three edge predicates. Complete and bounded requests preserve observed supporting edge records and source weights without demanding every unobserved orientation. Directed reciprocity must occur within one layer. Scope and endpoint values are caller-selected content, not wording decisions. Four core variants per kind and split are frozen as data; no language model runs at build time. Human wording review remains available.
